purpose: Live Power Stack thematic radar; dynamic ranking by freshness/materiality and current market significance. Theme rank changes research priority, not company fundamental scores.

environment.label: Capital scarcity + AI resilience + grid-access constraint
environment.summary: Long yields eased below 5% and AI/chips rallied, but restrictive policy remains. Texas' data-centre permit freeze converts grid access, self-supply, water and permitting from background issues into first-order AI infrastructure gates. Refined-product stress remains stronger than crude scarcity.

whatIsNewNow: Texas halted new state-issued data-centre permits pending grid audit; >470 GW of projects had queued.
EU proposed data-centre energy/water-efficiency disclosure for facilities >=500 kW.
Nasdaq hit a record while US 10Y eased below 5%, confirming selective AI resilience.
US-Belarus potash talks may ease potash affordability, but nitrogen/phosphate remain tighter farm-input constraints.
China is slowing humanoid IPOs after Unitree's reversal; revenue quality/commercial deployment now dominate hype.
Diesel/crack stress remains high even as crude risk premium eases.

themes.name: Capital Scarcity / Duration + Funded-vs-Unfunded
themes.whyNow: US 10Y eased to ~4.96-4.97% and risk assets rallied, but the Fed remains restrictive and another hike remains plausible.
themes.marketTransmission: project finance, equity multiples, credit, housing, capex hurdle rates
themes.confirmation: long yields remain elevated and weak projects require concessions
themes.invalidation: durable yield decline with improving credit/breadth and no renewed inflation
themes.nextTest: yield follow-through, credit, breadth and inflation expectations
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Prefer cash-generative contracted exposure; avoid duration-heavy averaging down.

themes.name: AI Infrastructure Demand + Grid Access / Permitting
themes.whyNow: AI/chips rallied to new highs, but Texas froze new data-centre permits pending a grid audit after >470 GW queued. Announced MW must now clear grid, self-supply, water and permitting tests.
themes.marketTransmission: data-centre finance, utilities, generation, permitting, supplier backlog, water/cooling
themes.confirmation: signed customers plus permits/interconnection/self-supply and FCF conversion
themes.invalidation: broad cancellations or rapid grid-capacity normalization
themes.nextTest: Texas audit, self-generation commitments, customer deposits and energised MW
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Favor suppliers solving real interconnection/self-supply bottlenecks; penalize speculative MW.

themes.name: Power / Grid / Electrical Bottlenecks + Self-Supply
themes.whyNow: Texas makes physical grid access the binding constraint; Amazon/Generac already validates behind-the-meter backup generation demand.
themes.marketTransmission: generation, backup power, transformers, switchgear, cables, utility capex
themes.confirmation: signed orders, funded projects, permits/interconnection and energised MW
themes.nextTest: Texas policy detail, supplier orders, customer deposits and YTL contracted load
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: YTLPOWR hold; GNRC priority research/no chase; ETN/PWR quality with valuation discipline.

themes.name: Middle East Refined Products + Shipping
themes.whyNow: Crude risk premium is easing, but diesel above $6.50 in current reporting and crack spreads near an 8-week high reinforce product tightness.
themes.marketTransmission: diesel, freight, tanker rates, inflation, farm/consumer margins
themes.confirmation: product cracks/freight stay stressed despite lower crude
themes.invalidation: route normalization plus product inventory and freight normalization
themes.nextTest: EIA products, diesel/cracks and tanker rates
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Hold existing energy; XOM support is live again; no war-premium chase.

themes.name: AI Memory / HBM Scarcity
themes.whyNow: AI-led semiconductor leadership remains strong and memory scarcity continues to matter for server BOM and supplier margins.
themes.marketTransmission: HBM/DRAM pricing, server BOM, semiconductor margins
themes.confirmation: HBM contracts and memory pricing remain firm
themes.invalidation: inventory correction or rapid supply response
themes.nextTest: memory pricing, inventories and capacity announcements
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: MU preferred listed US expression; no vertical chase.

themes.name: US LNG Rerouting + China Market Access
themes.whyNow: US LNG diversification remains structurally supported; China tariff discussions remain an upside catalyst rather than base-case proof.
themes.marketTransmission: US gas demand, LNG contracting, Asian/European gas prices
themes.confirmation: tariff cut, Chinese contracting and high utilization
themes.nextTest: US-China summit package and new SPAs
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: LNG remains top entry-asymmetry research candidate.

themes.name: Critical Minerals / Copper / Tungsten Security
themes.whyNow: Industrial shortages and strategic-policy competition continue to reinforce copper/tungsten security beyond price momentum alone.
themes.marketTransmission: AI hardware, grid capex, cables, defence, industrial policy
themes.confirmation: persistent physical premiums/shortages and funded orders
themes.nextTest: physical inventories/premiums and US-China policy language
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: FCX preferred-zone research; avoid speculative miners without cash flow.

themes.name: Agriculture / Fertilizer / Food Affordability
themes.whyNow: US-Belarus potash talks could ease potash cost, but nitrogen/phosphate and diesel remain more acute constraints. Input demand elasticity must remain segmented.
themes.marketTransmission: food inflation, farm margins, input volumes, machinery capex
themes.confirmation: crop/input ratios improve and export demand strengthens
themes.invalidation: farm margins deteriorate enough to cut core inputs
themes.nextTest: potash deal economics, nitrogen/phosphate prices, crop margins and diesel
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: CTVA/BG first; CF/NTR selective; VMI later; AGCO second-stage only.

themes.name: AI Security / Independent Model Evaluation
themes.whyNow: AI regulation/security requirements continue to broaden, but recurring revenue proof remains necessary.
themes.marketTransmission: cyber budgets, AI governance, consulting/evaluation spend

themes.name: Uranium / Nuclear Fuel + Buildout
themes.whyNow: Fuel-cycle localization and long-duration power remain strategic; no Sep 22 catalyst outranks grid, products or agriculture.
themes.marketTransmission: uranium contracting, enrichment, reactor supply chain
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: CCJ attractive research; maintain valuation discipline.

themes.name: Robotics / Automation Commercialization
themes.whyNow: China is slowing humanoid IPOs after Unitree's reversal and questioning state-backed revenue quality. Commercial deployment now matters more than thematic hype.
themes.marketTransmission: factory automation, machine vision, motion control, robotics capital markets
themes.confirmation: external recurring revenue and measurable productivity ROI
themes.nextTest: RoboTechnik Sep 24 HK pricing; external deployments
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Fixed/warehouse first; wait for HK pricing; humanoids remain selective.

themes.name: Gold / Silver / Miners
themes.whyNow: Gold remains resilient near $4,350 but restrictive policy and a firm dollar cap tactical upside.
themes.invalidation: real yields/dollar surge with weaker physical/ETF demand
themes.nextTest: real yields, dollar and central-bank/ETF flows

themes.name: ESS Demand vs Battery Manufacturing Overcapacity
themes.whyNow: RWE took FID on a 1.1 GWh Netherlands battery project and sodium-ion commercialization is advancing, but generic cell/miner overcapacity remains the gating risk.
themes.marketTransmission: storage integrators, cells, lithium pricing, utility capex
themes.nextTest: China approvals, deployments, sodium-ion economics and margins
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Favor storage cash conversion; generic lithium remains background/dormant.
